cell_choice_rule: the four cold-cache group leaders of the four Phase-4 production group types: 0 (low-drift), 148 (mid), 360 (old-313 region), 368 (terminal)
classification: NON-PRODUCTION; NON-DISPOSITION-BEARING; no cell obligation, T3/T4/T5 status, B_cover ratio or ledger is computed, read or written

decision_rules.cross_host_pass: every declared pair in R1 and R2 is byte-identical to the committed AWS record; no tolerance, containment or radius rule may be introduced after results
decision_rules.determinism_pass: R1 and R2 produce byte-identical canonical (nodes, geo) for every declared pair
decision_rules.diagnostic_replicate: R3 is reported only; it cannot turn a FAIL into PASS
decision_rules.runtime: the PS1 runtime fingerprint sha256 must equal the AWS runtime_contract_hash

not_authorised: any change to the PS1 authorization, topology or runtime contract table
pick_rule: stratified by AWS Phase-4 per-patch CPU rank, evenly spaced ranks incl. min and max; ties broken by patch index
predeclaration_sha256_note: sha256 of this file is recorded in the run log before the replicates start

producer.cache: cold per patch (identical to the production cells-outer worker)
producer.per_patch_function: opt_core.core (bound PS1 executor, frozen T2-closed certifier + bit-identical memoisation)

projection_rule: Vultr-equivalent CPU-h = AWS basis x (sum Vultr cpu_s / sum AWS cpu_s over the same cold-cache pairs); p90 per-pair ratio reported as the upper band

replicates.execution: three fresh interpreters started concurrently, pinned to distinct physical cores 2, 4, 6; six thread variables = 1
